task: Add a mechanism to auto-update the Claude agent's recommended/default models so users always get the latest models instead of stale hardcoded env-var defaults.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 3 components across 2 layers: claude.plugin.ts (modify), a new claude.models.ts resolver (create), and anthropic-subscription.template.ts (modify/reconcile) — cross-cutting between the agent-plugin and provider-plugin layers over two independently hardcoded model sources.

Task closely mirrors the existing Codex/Kimi/Copilot dynamic-resolver pattern but diverges: technical-analysis.md explicitly states the two hardcoded model sources (agent-plugin recommendedModels vs. anthropic-subscription's static alias table) are 'not obviously reconcilable under one fix', and a scope decision (CodeMie-proxied Claude only vs. also native Anthropic-subscription usage) is an open architectural question with no ADR or guide precedent to defer to.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped from L to XL: 'Similar to X but different' — Claude's needed dynamic-resolver mirrors the Codex/Kimi/Copilot pattern but has a second independent hardcoded model source (anthropic-subscription) with no documented reconciliation strategy.
